close_reason: Done in 03226e4. Added 'Do not simplify to rescan the whole buffer' inline block in the SSE delimiter-scan loop of subscribe_events enumerating four reasons for the 4-delimiter min_by_key + 3-byte overlap + UTF-8 char-boundary walk-back pattern. Test names cited rather than line numbers for stability.
description:
client.rs:460-479 in subscribe_events scans the SSE buffer for ANY of four delimiter forms (CRLF-CRLF, LF-LF, CR-CR, LF-CR-LF) starting from scan_from, then takes the EARLIEST match. scan_from is set to old_len.saturating_sub(3) after each chunk append (line 527), then walked back to a UTF-8 char boundary (lines 530-532).

A contributor may suggest 'just rescan buf[0..] each time, drop the scan_from tracking'. That's O(n²) on a hot streaming path.

Defense:
1. The 3-byte overlap is the MINIMUM that covers all four delimiter prefixes that can straddle a chunk boundary (
-prefix of 

, 
-prefix of 

, -prefix of , 
-prefix of 

). The comment at lines 449-459 walks through each case. Reducing the overlap loses delimiters that span chunks.
2. Searching ALL four delimiter forms and taking min_by_key handles the case where a server emits mixed line endings within a single frame (legal per RFC 8895 §9). A naive single-delimiter search misses these.
3. The walk-back to char boundary (lines 530-532) is necessary because  and 
 are single-byte but the byte preceding scan_from might be in the middle of a multi-byte codepoint. Without this, buf[scan_from..] would panic on the next .find().
4. Tests at tests/client_tests.rs:623, 673, 722 pin all three line-ending variants (CRLF-CRLF, LF-CR-LF, CR-CR) against hand-crafted server bodies. The mixed 

 case is the trickiest — it's not caught by 

 (the LFs are separated by ) and not by 

 (no leading 
). Test 673 confirms the explicit 

 search catches it.

This is defensive parsing against the union of WHATWG EventSource and RFC 8895 line-terminator rules. Resist requests to 'simplify' by removing the overlap tracking or the multi-delimiter search.
title: SSE 3-byte overlap rescan with min_by_key delimiter search: defend against 'rescan the whole buffer'
